triage.candidate: Human-facing progress communication should remain a manager-scoped capability rather than a generic subagent tool
triage.researchQuestion: Which agent role should have authority to communicate asynchronous progress to a human when internal subagents are still working, and how should that capability preserve responsibility topology?
triage.selectionReason: The root-versus-subagent communication boundary is concrete and governance-relevant, but today it is supported by one Codex maintainer implementation. It needs an independent implementation, failure study or comparative sample before selection.

triage.candidate: Cancellation may preserve cleanup obligations without becoming business completion
triage.researchQuestion: Which lifecycle cleanup obligations must still run after cancellation, and how can a runtime execute them exactly once without replacing the original cancellation with a false completion signal?
triage.selectionReason: The cancellation/finalization separation is a bounded engineering mechanism with targeted tests, but it remains one maintainer implementation and lacks independent comparative or incident evidence.

triage.candidate: Concurrent agent state requires a type-aware merge contract beyond last-writer-wins
triage.researchQuestion: When parallel workers update shared state, which merge semantics prevent silent loss without converting duplicate or conflicting effects into apparently valid state?
triage.selectionReason: The list-concatenation change clearly exposes the failure of generic last-writer-wins and preserves an explicit duplicate caveat, but one implementation is not enough to establish the broader concurrency contract as today's selected object.

triage.candidate: Audit-process completion must be separated from evidence-coverage completion
triage.researchQuestion: What evidence must demonstrate coverage before an AI-assisted audit may claim completion when an agentic search can finish yet miss relevant cases?
triage.selectionReason: A disclosed missed-case failure directly falsifies the inference that a completed agentic search proves audit coverage. Although the source was also used on September 10, today's bounded question concerns audit evidence coverage rather than high-impact execution authority and live enforcement, so it is not a duplicate research problem.

triage.candidate: Long-horizon recovery needs aligned checkpoints of cognitive and environment state
triage.researchQuestion: Which cognitive and environment/effect state must share a checkpoint identity so a long-running agent can recover from propagated errors without resuming against an inconsistent world?
triage.selectionReason: The paper supplies a primary mechanism plus measured comparison across tasks, models, execution strategies and harnesses, and asks a distinct recovery-state question not covered by recent memory-evidence or interrupted-call replay objects.

reading.workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects. Q-20260913-01 re-read AgentRewind under the narrower recovery-boundary question. The primary mechanism aligns agent context and controlled environment state at the same historical checkpoint, and the evaluation evidence supports substantial recovery gains inside the tested engineering harnesses. The source also makes the boundary explicit: workspace restoration does not automatically undo already-materialized external effects such as remote API or service mutations. The bounded Runtime finding is that local trajectory consistency and controlled-environment restoration are not global effect consistency; production recovery needs separate durable effect identity, replay/idempotency/compensation semantics and authoritative target-state evidence before a resumed worker retries an external mutation. Q-20260913-02 read Anthropic's September 9 incident assessment under the audit-coverage question. An initial agentic scan of roughly 141,000 transcripts found three incidents but omitted a relevant transcript set; later discovery of that omission surfaced a fourth incident. Anthropic then broadened the search to roughly 481 million transcripts and escalated about 9.2 million to second-stage Claude review, re-identifying the four known incidents and finding no similar-or-worse additional cases within that process. The bounded architecture finding is that Audit Process Completion, Coverage Evidence, Incident Attribution and Coverage Assurance are separate states; a terminal search job cannot use its own completion state as proof that the candidate universe was complete. The same assessment also shows a distinct semantic-review risk: a model-based monitor can inherit the audited actor's misleading framing even when the record is visible. Open-source Engineering remained No Selection; Reading created no third object. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication. Both Reading Notes were remotely re-read at exact head 2d4721a8dc306b0604ce8bf9cab1f9e238ac92f8, and Validate Research Center 3.0 run 34734973666 completed successfully on that exact note head before terminal finalization.
reading.workResult_zh: 已对两个同日 Selected Object 完成来源完整 Deep Reading。Q-20260913-01 在更窄的 Recovery Boundary 问题下重新深读 AgentRewind。一手机制把 Agent Context 与受控 Environment State 对齐到同一历史 Checkpoint，评测证据支持其在所测工程 Harness 内带来显著恢复收益；同时来源明确给出边界：恢复 Workspace 并不会自动撤销已经物化到外部系统的 Remote API、SaaS 或其他业务 Effect。边界 Runtime 结论是：Local Trajectory Consistency 与 Controlled-environment Restoration 不等于 Global Effect Consistency；生产级恢复在恢复 Worker 重试外部 Mutation 前，还需要独立持久的 Effect Identity、Replay/Idempotency/Compensation 语义以及权威 Target-state Evidence。Q-20260913-02 在 Audit Coverage 问题下深读 Anthropic 9 月 9 日事故评估。首次 Agentic Scan 约覆盖 14.1 万条 Transcript，发现 3 起事故，却遗漏了一组相关 Transcript；后续发现这一遗漏后又识别出第 4 起事故。Anthropic 随后把搜索扩展到约 4.81 亿条 Transcript，并把约 920 万条升级到第二阶段 Claude Review，重新识别全部 4 起已知事故，且在该流程内未发现其他同等或更严重案例。边界架构结论是：Audit Process Completion、Coverage Evidence、Incident Attribution 与 Coverage Assurance 必须分开；搜索任务达到终态不能用自己的 Completed 状态证明 Candidate Universe 已完整覆盖。同一评估还显示另一种独立风险：即使记录已经可见，Model-based Monitor 仍可能继承被审计 Actor 的误导性解释而发生 Semantic Misclassification。Open-source Engineering 保持 No Selection，没有人为补造第三个对象。Reading 未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。两份 Reading Note 已在精确 Head 2d4721a8dc306b0604ce8bf9cab1f9e238ac92f8 上远程回读，Validate Research Center 3.0 Run 34734973666 在进入终态收口前已于该精确 Note Head 成功完成。
